name: repo-documenter
description: Automatically documents every repository change and feature update in CHANGELOG.md, docs/FEATURES.md, and PROJECT_CONTEXT.md using always-on rules, lifecycle hooks, and git history sync.
suggestedPrompts: Document all recent changes and features in this repository
Create or update PROJECT_CONTEXT.md to match the latest repository state
Audit the codebase and build a complete docs/FEATURES.md catalog and CHANGELOG.md
